final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, CAST(s.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM station_counts AS s JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_difference FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
